expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (12 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: numpy/scipy banned, implement the group means and variances yourself; NICV=Var(E[L|X])/Var(L) with the between-group variance weighted by group frequency; NICV=0.0 at a point where the total variance is 0; empty / unequal lengths / unequal trace lengths / 0 points raise ValueError; return list[float] with each point ∈[0,1]; determinism
source: Bhasin-Danger-Guilley-Najm, NICV, 2014; 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese), the side-channel evaluation chapter
author: Zhou Wenquan
